import zipfile, subprocess, os, random
z=zipfile.ZipFile('src-vul/xaac_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for name in z.namelist()[:16]:
    base=bytearray(z.read(name))
    for i in range(10):
        d=bytearray(base)
        for _ in range(50):
            idx=random.randrange(len(d)); d[idx]=random.randrange(256)
        path='/tmp/mut.aac'
        open(path,'wb').write(d)
        p=subprocess.run(['timeout','4','./work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer',path],capture_output=True,text=True)
        if p.returncode not in (0,124):
            print('FOUND',name,i,p.returncode)
            print(p.stderr[-1000:])
            raise SystemExit
print('none')
